# Rayid Ali

> AI engineer in New York City. Builds AI products end to end and ships them, usually alone.

Site: https://rayidali.com
Contact: via the mail button on the site. GitHub: https://github.com/rayidali. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rayidali

## Now
- AI engineer by day (applied LLM and computer vision pipelines in production).
- Founder by night: Cinechrony, an iPhone and web app.

## Projects
- Cinechrony (https://www.cinechrony.com): keep the films you find scrolling. Share a reel and it pulls out every film into a watchlist you share with friends. Next.js, Swift, Capacitor, Postgres. Built solo.
- iEdit (https://iedit.dev): an AI video editor that lives in iMessage. Text it clips and a vibe; it picks the cut, music, overlays and grade, then texts the video back. TypeScript, Claude, Shotstack.
- pdf2video (https://github.com/rayidali/pdf2video): a research paper in, a narrated animated video presentation out. Python.

## Publication
- Ali, R. (2022). Leveraging Network Similarity Measures for Recommendation Systems. IEEE ICETCI 2022. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9921383

## Education
- MS, Computer Science, Clemson University (2024). Research with MIT Lincoln Laboratory on multi agent reinforcement learning.

Python, TypeScript, Swift, Go, SQL, React, Next.js, FastAPI, Node, PyTorch, LLM and RAG pipelines (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), pgvector, Pinecone, Postgres, BigQuery, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Vercel.
